notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy Howdy howdy[/h1]

You'll no doubt be pleased to hear that [b] Schrodinger's Cat Burglar[/b] works great on the Steam Deck.

If you have trouble running the game, setting Compatibility to Proton 9.0 should do the trick.

Currently the control information still shows keyboard bindings if no keyboard is connected.  That's on the list of things to improve!

If the framerate is a little low I recommend making sure Fur Quality is set to Off, and reducing Graphics quality to Medium or so.

Have fun, you crazy cats!

Martin and the Abandoned Sheep team

notes.title: Patch notes 0.204
notes.notes:

A little patch to help with the keyboard controls :

[h2]- Version 0.204[/h2]
[list]
[*]Revamped binding menu - now you can filter bindings by type, and you have to apply changes rather than having them occur immediately
[*]Added menu function controls to the pause screen controls
[*]Reorganized menu bindings - pause is on Escape, codex is now on Return and back is on Backspace
[*]Improved ‘left shift’ and ‘right shift’ icons
[*]Made it so that the cat is always cat1 when fused in single player (meaning input prompts are more appropriate)
[*]Fixed a few graphical issues
[*]Tweaked a few puzzle elements to be more friendly to players
[/list]

Still more work to do on the inputs front, but hopefully this makes things a bit easier for now!

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase - Brand New Demo!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Demo Leaps Onto Steam 🐱 (Presumably Scatters Papers)[/h1]

With the wealth of incredible demos available to play during online showcases it can make you wish you could be in two places at the same time – well, in Schrödinger’s Cat Burglar, you can do exactly that! 
[b]A brand new demo is ready to play on Steam NOW![/b] ⤵️

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493170/Schrodingers_Cat_Burglar_Demo/]Schrodinger's Cat Burglar Demo[/url][/h1]

[h2]PARTICULARLY EXCITING NEW FEATURES[/h2]
The updated demo promises a quantum adventure that’s one of a kind and includes a bunch of charming new features we know you’ll love. 

🔬 A whole brand new level!
🤯 New mechanic, item splitting.
🎩 New hats, new emotes.
🏃🏻‍♀️‍➡️ Improved parkour! Smoother movement.
🤔 New hint system.
🔄 Yes. You can chase your own tail. 
👥 Got a buddy? Play in drop-in/drop-out local co-op! (compatible with Steam Remote Play Together)
🤫 Top secret cheat code: up, down, top, bottom, strange, charm.

[h2]SO WHERE CAN I PLAY?[/h2]
The brand new [b]Schrodinger’s Cat Burglar demo[/b] is playable across two amazing festivals happening this month:
[h3]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/h3]
Head on over to Steam from 29th May to 5th June to discover your next favourite puzzle game!
➡ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Check it out here[/url].
[h3]Frosty Games Fest[/h3]
Tune in on 8th June at 9am AEST for the inaugural celebration of exciting indie games made in Australia and New Zealand. 
➡ [url=https://www.frostygamesfest.com]Check it out here[/url].

[h2](SUB) ATOMIC KITTEN[/h2]
Control Mittens the cat in this new take on the classic puzzle heist adventure. Infiltrating a secret facility, Mittens stumbles into a quantum experiment, granting her the ability to be in two places at once – but that’s not the half of it!

The quantum superstate obeys [i]Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle[/i] - when nobody is looking, Mittens could be in either location. Introduce an observer however, and things get theoretical...

🚪 Pass through doors (that could theoretically have opened).
🚓 Avoid security detection (you can’t see what doesn’t exist).
🧵 Quantum mechanics plus cats. No strings attached. What’s not to love! 

Stretch the realms of what’s plausible with quantum mechanics. And when’s the game coming out, you ask? Well, theoretically when unobserved it could be at any point… more on that soon! 

✉️ [url=https://abandonedsheep.com/newsletter]Subscribe to our newsletter for more[/url]

Or follow along with our antics on social media
🦋 [url=https://bsky.app/profile/abandonedsheep.com]Bluesky[/url]
🆇 [url=https://x.com/_AbandonedSheep]Twitter[/url]
🎵 [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@quantumcatgame]TikTok[/url]

Most importantly, if you haven’t already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111550/Schrodingers_Cat_Burglar/]don’t forget to WISHLIST![/url] 

Thanks,
Martin and the Abandoned Sheep team.

notes.title: Demo updated with new ending!
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

We have an exciting update for you all.

[h1]The demo has been updated with a new ending![/h1]

If you've played the demo before, you can skip straight to the new stuff thanks to the improved New Game menu!

Starting a new game presents you with three options :

[b]1) Play the Full Demo[/b]
If you've not played before, and you're happy to enjoy the build up, this is the best option.  The whole experience can take an hour or more.

[b]2) Co-operative Cut[/b]
If you want to play with a friend, or you want to cut to the chase, this is the best option.  It starts the game when you get your powers, with co-operative mode activated.  You can disable co-operative mode from the menu if you want to play solo.

[b]3) Skip to the End[/b]
If you've played the demo before, this drops you in right at the new stuff.

There have also been a few bug fixes and improvements all over.  Thank you to everyone who has played and streamed the demo so far - you've helped improve the game already!

Patch notes for the update :

- March 7 (version 0.1.03)
    - New start menu with three start points
    - Exciting new content at the end of the demo
    - Improved reward UI
    - Emote and Hat UI stays on screen
    - Robots will no longer squash cats through walls
    - Slightly improved jumping

notes.title: Demo patched - version 0.0.06
notes.notes:
Ahoyhoy folks!

It took a while to get it working, but we now have Co-op with one player on Keyboard and the other on Controller working!

In the Control Settings is a new option - "Use Keyboard as Co-Op Player 2" - turning this on will allow one player to use keyboard controls with the other using a game controller.

Also, information was added to the Codex note on Co-operative Controls detailing how to get Remote Play Together working with Keyboard Co-op.

The trick is to flush the controllers (from the settings menu) and then add the controllers again once Remote Play is active.  In Keyboard Co-op mode, the host player will have to use the keyboard.

Patch notes follow!

- Feb 14 (version 0.0.06)
    - Controller and keyboard co-op support added
    - Improved pop up help to include alternate message for co-op mode
    - Allowed co-op mode to be started before the cat gains her powers
    - Added information to the Co-operative Controls codex entry detailing how to use Keyboard Co-op and Remote Play Together.
    - Accidentally put the wrong version number and date in the build, so this patch is now from the future
